metadata.instruction: Add a focused aimayatool.tools.scene CreateIK module and Python smoke. Keep pure normalization/geometry planning separate from Maya mutation. Require exactly three explicit source objects; compute/validate a non-collinear three-point plane and deterministic pole-vector position in Python. Represent parent/worldParent and naming inputs in the plan. At the Maya boundary compose existing Setup primitives where semantics match: transforms.insert_offset_group/create_joints_at_references, controls.create_control/create_zero_group, ikfk.create_rp_ik/create_ikfk_blend/wire_ikfk_switch, spaces.create_space_switch. Do not duplicate these helpers and do not copy legacy UI, JSON IO, PyMEL, NLTA modules, or reload patterns. The first slice may stop before full host construction if a reusable primitive mismatch is discovered, but it must return a precise structured gap rather than silently reimplementing it. Add focused deterministic tests for three-object normalization, non-collinear geometry/pole position, collinear rejection, and stable naming/plan output. Compile/import/test changed Python, commit and push product/test changes to main. Do not use Codex.
acceptance: Scene CreateIK planning is deterministic and Maya-independent.
Exactly three source objects are required and duplicates are rejected.
Collinear three-point input is rejected before mutation.
Pole-vector position and plane basis are deterministic for valid positions.
Existing Setup primitives are reused rather than copied.
No NLTA/PyMEL/UI/legacy JSON coupling is introduced.
Focused Python smoke covers normalization, geometry, rejection, and naming/plan output.
Changed Python compiles/imports and focused tests pass before commit/push.
